inventoryRule: operations must equal the routes actually registered by sourceModules (tests/contract/ws27-contracts.test.ts compares against Fastify onRoute).
sharedBehaviors: Participation is decided by the ledger row (expert_member_id or customer_member_id), never by a client flag. A non-participant gets 404 LEDGER_NOT_FOUND so the ledger's existence is not disclosed.
Ordering is (created_at DESC, id DESC). The id tiebreak keeps a total order for rows written in the same millisecond.
before is the id of the last message already seen. The server resolves it inside the same ledger and returns strictly older rows, so pages have no duplicates or gaps.
Query values arrive as strings because the app runs with ajv coerceTypes:false; numeric bounds are enforced in the handler (limit > 100 => 400 INVALID_LIMIT).
All routes respond with Cache-Control: no-store and X-Server-Time.

errors.when: schema violation (missing/too long body, unknown property, bad uuid)
body is only whitespace (passes minLength, violates the table trim CHECK)
ledger does not exist or caller is not a participant

operations.notes: Default limit 50, maximum 100. nextCursor is null when the page is the last one.

errors.when: limit is not an integer in 1..100
before is unknown or belongs to another ledger
schema violation (bad uuid, limit not matching ^[1-9][0-9]{0,2}$)
ledger does not exist or caller is not a participant

openItems: Deletion policy is undecided at v0.1: chat_messages.deleted_at exists and is returned as deletedAt, but no route writes or filters on it. Every message is still returned with its body. The user-confirmed delete policy (own messages only, counterpart sees a deleted placeholder) is wave-3 WS-25 and will change this contract to v0.2.
read_at is returned but no route marks messages as read yet.
No retention/purge policy is defined for chat messages.
